postings.title: Accounts Payable Rents Administrator
postings.description:
Bauer Media Outdoor UK is one of the UK’s largest Out of Home media and infrastructure companies, operating more than 33,000 advertising sites nationwide and employing 600+ people in 14 locations. Our mission is To Create the Future of Media, transforming our estate to the benefit of all our stakeholders, through data-driven innovations and infrastructure.
Our purpose is to provide both A Platform for Brands & A Platform for Good, delivering on advertisers’ media objectives whilst having a positive impact on the world around us. 

About the role....
We’re looking for an Accounts Payable Rents Administrator to join our Finance team based in Woking. In the role, you’ll be ensuring accurate and timely payments to Landlords, and you’ll efficiently manage all rents queries from Landlords and colleagues.   
You’ll manage all aspects of rental payments; ensuring the process runs seamlessly and payments are made on time. You’ll utilise regular reports to understand current and legacy liabilities, and you’ll be able to forecast future cash requirements. 

- Being the first point of contact for Landlords and colleague payment enquiries, demonstrating a confident and professional approach, able to manage own workload with minimal supervision 

- Manual Invoice postings  

- Registration of unapproved invoices  

- Recording manual invoices for non-Fusion sites and to release VAT   

- Ensure timely payments are made according to contractual due dates.  

- Liaising with the Development team and Landlords regarding contract and payment queries   

- Being the first point of contact for rental payment enquiries, demonstrating a confident and professional approach   

- Weekly payment runs from two systems  

- Partnering with Portfolio and MI teams for seamless operations 

- Cashflow preparation and commentary  

- Set up new suppliers and make necessary amendments   

- Producing payment reports from the Fusion rents system according to contractual due dates for forecasting and payment run purposes   

- Producing BACS files according to scheduled payment dates   

- Ensuring incoming emails are actioned daily and managing own workload   

- Actively reviewing and investigating any unpaid items   

- Monthly Statement reconciliations   

Who are you.... 

- An understanding of the Accounts Payable workflow, from receipt of invoice through to payment would be advantageous   

- A good working understanding of how and when to account for VAT   

- Strong accuracy and attention to detail and great organisational skills   

- Experience of dealing with enquiries from external suppliers and landlords would be ideal   

- Confident and professional communication skills   

- Knowledge of Microsoft Office programmes, specifically Excel   

- Excellent team player, who’s happy to help when required   

- Beneficial to have experience with Rent invoicing 

- Beneficial to have experience with D365 
Role Expectations 

- Professional & Effective Communication 

- Maintain clear and timely communication with your team and management. 
Ownership & Accountability 

- Take full responsibility for managing your assigned accounts. 

- Ensure all tasks, particularly month-end reporting and reconciliations, are completed accurately and within required deadlines. 

What's in it for you?
Our people are bonded by a humility and commitment to challenge the status quo. We offer a great team to be a part of a home for your individuality, as well as a place to bring fresh ideas and to grow and develop. We have a fun and informal culture while also being a future-facing business that wants to make a difference. So, Bring you. Shape us.

- Annual Bonus OTE -8% 

- Flexible working (this generally looks like 3 days in our offices and 2 days at home)

postings.title: Construction Operative
postings.description:
Are you an experienced construction worker who has some experience in simple groundworks and installation?
Would you be interested in training to gain your HGV Class 2 Driving Licence?
If you’re someone who can learn on the job and turn your hand to various manual tasks, then this role could be what you are looking for.
Who are we?
Bauer Media Outdoor are a leading Out of Home media owner, operating more than 33,000 advertising sites nationwide. We are a friendly and culture led company who value and support our employees to be the best they can be. We also care about the communities we work with and the environment too! 
We’re excited to be working on some interesting projects this year and now looking for Construction Operatives to join our growing team in Dartford. 

What will you be doing?
You’ll be working as part of a two-person crew, spending most of your day breaking up ground and replacing / installing new digital units and bus shelters for our local communities. You’ll must be willing to train to drive a HGV Class 2 Vehicle to help you do this.
This role will involve travelling to sites (roadsides and public areas) in the London, Essex and Kent areas, plus occasional travel further afield and some night working dependent upon business needs - sufficient notice will be given with lodgings and reasonable overnight expenses provided.
You’ll receive an attractive salary of £39,250, which will increase to £42,400 once you have passed your HGV Class 2 . You will also enjoy an annual bonus, paid annual leave 25 days plus bank holidays, opportunities for training and development and fully expensed tools and PPE. 
It’s a physically demanding role which requires you to work at height, mainly using a small step ladder, so you’ll need to be a team player and watch/help out your crew partner. 
If you’re not Class 2 HGV qualified then we’ll train you up and cover the costs, however you must be able to commute independently to and from our Dartford Depot, in your own transport.

Responsibilities & Accountabilities:

- Transport digital units from the depot to the installation site via a HGV truck (after training)
- Break ground and install digital units.
- Replace component level parts on digital units.
- Work with your crew partner to manage your workload within the agreed timescales, and in partnership with other local teams.
- Follow the Construction Design and Management regulations 2015.
- Make sure traffic management is in place before starting work with segregation/prevention measures to prevent unauthorised people within your working area.
- Follow our Health and Safety policy and the site-specific risk assessments and method statements. 
- Correctly use equipment (including working at height), maintain and keep tools/equipment safe on site.

Knowledge, Experience and Attributes:

- Full driving licence with no more than 3 points
- Experience in civils groundwork
- CPCS Slinger preferred
- Competency in CAT use.
- NRSWA accreditation to Operative standard 
- Excavation and sub-structure knowledge
- Understanding of RAMS
- Ability to read and understand technical drawings
- Competency in use of power tools such as Hydraulic breakers and Disc Saws 

What’s in it for you?

- Salary is £39,250 per annum (with potential overtime opportunities)
- Annual bonus up to 8% of your annual salary
- 33 days holiday inc. bank holidays
- Company Pension Scheme matched to 8% 
- Life Insurance and Income Protection scheme
- Healthcare Cash Plan
- Cycle to work scheme, season ticket loans and a whole host of discounts across 100s of retailers
- Social events
- Volunteering days
- Employee Discounts across hundreds of retailers

Sound like the job role for you? Why not apply today!

At Bauer Media Outdoor, we are committed to treating everyone with fairness and respect, regardless of their race, gender, age, ethnicity, background, sexual orientation, disability, or any other differences. We work hard to foster an inclusive environment, a place you can be yourself. We support reasonable adjustment requests from candidates and employees. If you're interested in joining us to shape the future of out-of-home media, we'd love to hear from you.

postings.title: Electrician
postings.description:
Who are we?   

You've probably seen our work without even realising it! 

Bauer Media Outdoor is behind many of the adverts, bus shelters and digital screens you see every day, from busy high streets and shopping centres to roads, transport hubs and local neighbourhoods. 

We're one of the UK's leading Out of Home media and infrastructure companies, operating more than 33,000 sites nationwide and looking after nearly 22,000 bus shelters. With teams across the UK, we combine advertising with the delivery and maintenance of public infrastructure that communities rely on every day. 

We're part of Bauer Media Group, one of the world's largest privately owned media groups, with a rich heritage in media and a commitment to developing our people. 

Are you a qualified Electrician looking for a new challenge? 
Have you completed the 18th Edition wiring regulations course? 

What will the role involve? 
As a Bauer Media Outdoor Electrician, you’ll be responsible for maintaining, testing and repairing the electrical systems across our digital advertising infrastructure. Based at our Gateshead depot, you’ll carry out routine electrical inspections, fault finding, wiring, lighting replacements and general maintenance, ensuring all work meets health and safety standards and is completed efficiently. You’ll also use handheld technology to record completed works and manage stock accurately. With a fully expensed company vehicle, flexible working and ongoing training, this is a great opportunity to join our team. 

What will you be doing?

- Fault finding: Identify, investigate and resolve 

- Replacing fuses, tubes, lighting. 

- Using handheld technology to record work.

- Trained to 18th Edition IEE or current electrical regulations. 

- City & Guilds 2330 Level 2 & 3 Electrical Installation (or equivalent) 

- City & Guilds 2391 or 2395 Inspection & Testing is a nice to have! 

- Current UK Driving Licence holder or equivalent. 

- Comfortable working outdoors in all weathers 

- Ability to work at height. 

- Flexible attitude – be open to on call duties and overtime. 

What’s in it for you?

What are we looking for? 

- 3-5 years' experience in excavation works involving Utilities 

- NRSWA qualified
- Traffic Management knowledge and the understanding of correct procedures

- Experience with working at height – Use of step ladders, tower scaffolding and MEMPs

postings.title: Inventory Administrator 12 Months FTC
postings.description:
Do you naturally ask “why?” and enjoy tracking issues back to their root cause? 
Are you System savvy?  Comfortable navigating different systems, learning new tools and understanding how they link together? 
Are you able to commit to a fixed term contract of 12 months? 
If this sounds like you we have the perfect role for you! 
We are now looking to recruit a Inventory Administrator on a fixed term contract of 12 months. 

About Us 
Bauer Media Outdoor UK is one of the leading Out of Home media owners, with more than 33,000 advertising sites in our portfolio. Our talented team of over 650 people work in 14 locations across the country, creating and delivering some of the most memorable advertising campaigns in the UK.    
At Bauer Media Outdoor, we are committed to Creating the Future of Media. We’re at the forefront of the change in our industry, making innovative use of technology and realising the potential of Out of Home media.   

About the role 
The Stock Co-ordinator is responsible for maintaining accurate stock records, supporting day to day inventory operations and ensuring that our systems always reflect the reality in the warehouse. The role suits someone who is highly organised, comfortable working with complex systems and enjoys digging into the detail to understand how and why things happen.  
You’ll work closely with Operations, Finance and Procurement teams to make sure stock is in the right place, in the right quantity, at the right time.  

Key Responsibilities:
Stock Control & Data Accuracy  

- Maintain accurate stock levels across our systems (e.g. ERP/WMS/stock management tools).  

- Process stock movements including receipts, transfers, adjustments and write offs.  

- Regularly reconcile system records with physical counts and investigate discrepancies.  

- Prepare and support cycle counts and full stocktakes, including follow up actions.  
Administration & Documentation  

- Ensure all stock documentation (delivery notes, GRNs, pick lists, returns forms) is complete, accurate and properly filed.  

- Ensure the integrity of our product records is maintained in D365  

- Generate routine stock reports (e.g. slow-moving items, stock valuation, stock integrity) for internal stakeholders. 
Systems & Process Support  

- Confidently navigate multiple systems and databases to retrieve, check and update stock information.  

- Support the implementation or change of stock-related processes and system improvements.  

- Act as a point of contact for stock queries from internal teams, resolving issues quickly or escalating where necessary.  
Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement  

- Proactively investigate anomalies, trends and recurring issues in stock data.  

- Identify process gaps or inefficiencies and suggest practical improvements.  

- Work with colleagues to standardise and document best practice in stock administration.  
Collaboration & Communication  

- Liaise with Procurement, Finance and Construction teams to ensure smooth stock flow.  

- Communicate clearly about stock issues, risks and deadlines so that other teams can plan effectively.  

- Build strong working relationships and provide support and training on stock processes where needed.  

What we’re looking for… 

- Strong administration skills with excellent attention to detail and accuracy.  

- Comfortable working with numbers, spreadsheets and databases.  

- Experience using stock, ERP or warehouse management systems (or clear aptitude to learn complex systems quickly).  

- Proven ability to manage and prioritise multiple tasks and deadlines.  

- Previous experience in a stock, inventory, logistics or operations role is preferred 

- Intermediate Excel skills (e.g. filters, lookups, pivot tables).  

- Experience participating in or coordinating stocktakes and reconciliations would be beneficial 

What is in it for you?

- Salary of £28,000- £32,000
- Flexible working and a hybrid setup that gives the freedom to have your work -life balance 

- Enjoy 25 paid holidays, as well as the well needed bank holidays! 

- Company Pension Scheme Contribution of up to 8% 

- Stay healthy with our Healthcare Cash Plan 

- Life Insurance and group income protection scheme 

- Cycle to Work Scheme + Enjoy travel/season ticket loans and exclusive discounts with hundreds of retailers 

- Make a difference with our charity volunteer days. It feels great to give back!

postings.title: Lead AI Engineer
postings.description:

We're one of the leading media advertising companies with over 33,000 advertising sites across the UK and EU. As part of the global Bauer Media Group, we're committed to being both a platform for brands and a platform for good. From Netflix, Disney, The National Lottery, Heineken and many more, we advertise for some of the best brands which reach millions of people every day! We don't just sell space, we deliver impact for our clients and value for the communities we serve.
📍London - 2 days a week | 💰 Salary for this role is dependant on your experience, you'll also receive bonus + benefits

About The Role
You'll join our AI Enablement team at Bauer Media Outdoor. This role is focused on designing, building and deploying AI enabled software solutions that are used across the organisation. You'll work closely with Product Leads to shape and deliver real solutions, including building custom AI Assistants within our internal generative AI platform, Bauer AI Chat. You'll be accountable for technical problem solving, system design, AI integration and delivering production quality code that creates clear business value. What You'll Be Doing
- Identifying opportunities where AI products could be built and released in various teams across Bauer.
- Building and deploying greenfield products across the company used internally and externally.
- You'll have alot of freedom here, the team will run with your ideas!
- Communicate technical decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders and ensure smooth user experiences.

What You'll Bring To The Team
- Strong backend expertise preferably in Python with solid understanding of istributed systems, APIs, microservices, and secure software design.
- Proven experience integrating AI/LLM-based services into production; experience in ML or computer vision is beneficial but not essential.
- Comfortable owning projects end to end, and bringing non technical stakeholders on the journey with you.

What's In It For You
🏖️ 25 paid holidays including bank holidays
🏠 Company Pension Scheme paid up to 8%
🩺 Healthcare Cash Plan
🛡️ Life Insurance and group income protection scheme
🚲 Cycle to work scheme

postings.title: Principal Civil and Structural Engineer
postings.description:
🚀Our mission is to create tech that makes a difference, empowers teams, delights customers, and shapes the media world of tomorrow

We’re one of the leading media advertising companies with over 33,000 advertising sites across the UK and EU.

As part of the global Bauer Media Group, we’re committed to being both a platform for brands and a platform for good. From Netflix, Disney, The National Lottery, Heineken and many more, we advertise for some of the best brands which reach millions of people every day! We don’t just sell space, we deliver impact for our clients and value for the communities we serve.

📍London - 2 days a week | 💰 Salary for this role is dependent on experience, you’ll also receive bonus + benefits

About The Role
We’re looking for a Principal Civil and Structural Engineer with civil engineering and foundation-design capability to join our forward thinking and market leading European Product Development team in London. This team is responsible for delivering centrally developed and centrally sourced, sustainable Street Furniture, Display and Smart product portfolio, while assisting countries with product and tender strategy.
At Bauer Media Outdoor, we operate over 248,000 digital and traditional displays, partnering with cities and transport authorities to create cleaner, smarter public spaces. Our team sits at the forefront of this transformation, combining green infrastructure, smart technology, and innovative design to support major tenders and drive toward our science-based net-zero targets.
You'll be the internal authority on structural integrity - owning the complete load path from the shelter roof, glazing and digital displays down through the frame, connections, foundations and ground. You'll work alongside our mechanical and product engineering team and you'll bridge the gap between bespoke fabricated structures and permanent civil works.

What you'll be doing
- Act as the subject matter expert in structural and foundation engineering across the full load path - designing and verifying steel and aluminium superstructures, glazing supports, primary/secondary frames, connections, and anchoring systems.
- Engineer standard and site-specific foundation solutions (reinforced concrete, precast, and modular) to suit varying ground conditions.
- Ensure structural integrity against wind, snow, impact, vibration, and maintenance loads.
- Design for safe installation and lifecycle operations, incorporating lifting points, clear installation sequences, replaceable components, and safe maintenance access.
- Lead structural approval of complete systems alongside 3rd-party verifiers, delivering structural calculations, drawings, specifications, and design-risk assessments for external stakeholders.
- Support the development and standardisation of modular product structures, assemblies, and metadata to enable scalable variants and product configurator capabilities.
- Create and maintain accurate engineering BOMs (eBOMs) and product hierarchies within PTC Windchill.

What you'll bring to the team
- Degree in Civil or Structural Engineering.
- Strong experience designing bespoke fabricated steel and aluminium structures, rather than solely conventional buildings.
- Practical foundation and ground-engineering experience, with deep knowledge of welded and bolted connections, sheet metal, extrusions, baseplates, and anchors.
- Working knowledge of Eurocodes, UK National Annexes, CDM 2015, and relevant fabrication standards.

Nice to have
- Proficiency in PTC Creo CAD software and CAD management techniques, alongside familiarity with PLM systems (PTC Windchill preferred).

What's in it for you
🏖️ 25 paid holidays + bank holidays
🏠 Company Pension Scheme paid up to 8%
🩺 Healthcare Cash Plan
🛡️ Life Insurance and group income protection scheme
🚲 Cycle to work scheme
🤱🏻 Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Cover

We believe in fairness and as an equal opportunities employer we work hard to foster an inclusive environment, a place where you can truly be yourself and be treated fairly. postings.title: Quality and Sustainability Manager
postings.location: Bolton, United Kingdom · Westhoughton, United Kingdom
postings.description:
About the role 
Its purpose is to ensure that Bauer Media Outdoor Technic’s (BMOT’s) ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 accreditations are continually monitored, audited, and maintained in line with the evolving needs of the business, while also ensuring alignment with the wider Bauer Media Outdoor (BMO) Group strategy.
In addition, the role will support the delivery of design intent by reviewing engineering and manufacturing specifications, monitoring materials for defects, and resolving quality issues. This includes ensuring that root cause analysis is completed and that appropriate corrective and preventative actions are identified and communicated back into the business and/or to suppliers, depending on the root cause of the quality concern.

What you’ll be doing

- Champion BMOT’s commitment to the highest quality standards, driving a culture of continuous improvement across the organisation.
- Take responsibility for BMOT’s ISO 9001 Quality Management System and ISO 14001 Environmental Management System, including the development, communication, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of each system.
- Maintain and conduct a rolling programme of internal audits to ensure departmental compliance with both management systems. Provide departmental leaders with clear guidance on improvement initiatives and priorities arising from audits, standard revisions, or identified non-conformities.
- Compile and monitor BMOT’s EcoVadis submission, coordinating with the wider BMO Group Compliance team to ensure corrective actions are identified, prioritised, and completed in line with agreed target schedules.
- Identify and support environmental sustainability initiatives in line with BMOT objectives and the wider BMO Group strategy.
- Monitor all non-conformities, including supplier NCRs, internal audit findings, and escaping defects. Conduct trend analysis on repeat failure modes and ensure targeted corrective and preventative actions are communicated to relevant departments.
- Work with the Engineering and Purchasing departments to define key material quality assurance measures, develop supply specifications, and establish third-party quality assurance inspection and reporting requirements where appropriate.
- Collaborate with Design and Procurement teams to research, source, and assess suitable vendors for the supply of required products and materials.
- Conduct regular supplier quality control audits to ensure vendors continue to operate in compliance with BMOT requirements, company standards, and applicable legal and regulatory obligations.
- Maintain detailed supplier quality reports, including defect rates, recurring issues, audit findings, and areas contributing to non-conformance.
What you'll need

- In-depth knowledge of ISO 9001 and ISO 14001, including the implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of one or both management systems.
- Strong knowledge and practical experience of quality tools and methodologies, including Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), Production Part Approval Process (PPAP), and Lean Manufacturing techniques.
- Proven ability to identify and implement improvement initiatives based on data analysis of historical NCRs, escaping defects, audit findings, and quality trends.
- Flexible approach to work, with a willingness to travel when required. A full driving licence is essential.
Essential qualifications & experience

- At least 5 years’ experience in a quality assurance role
- Relevant Quality Management, Manufacturing or Engineering related degree is preferred or;
- HND, BTEC Professional Level 5 Qualification, equivalent NVQ Level 5 qualification or; equivalent Electronics Degree
- Strong knowledge and practical experience of quality tools and methodologies, including Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), Production Part Approval Process (PPAP), and Lean Manufacturing techniques.
Desirable

- Experience in providing data and supporting evidence for EcoVadis submissions. Experience in leading an EcoVadis submission would be a distinct advantage.

What’s in it for you?

- An annual salary of £55,000 -£65,000 DOE + bonus
- 25 days plus bank holidays
- This role is Monday to Friday 8am – 4pm, with Fridays worked from home

- Social events and activities

postings.description:
Who are we?  
You've probably seen our work without even realising it!

Bauer Media Outdoor is behind many of the adverts, bus shelters and digital screens you see every day, from busy high streets and shopping centres to roads, transport hubs and local neighbourhoods.

We're one of the UK's leading Out of Home media and infrastructure companies, operating more than 33,000 sites nationwide and looking after nearly 22,000 bus shelters. With teams across the UK, we combine advertising with the delivery and maintenance of public infrastructure that communities rely on every day.

We're part of Bauer Media Group, one of the world's largest privately owned media groups, with a rich heritage in media and a commitment to developing our people.

About the Role
We are looking for an organised and analytical Service Parts & Inventory Analyst to take ownership of our digital screen buffer stock across the UK and Europe. Working within BMOT, our manufacturing depot who are responsible for designing and producing our digital advertising screens, you ‘ll play an important role in maintaining stock availability and ensuring service uptime.
You will manage stock levels, ordering, replenishment, demand planning, returns and reporting across multiple product groups and locations. Working closely with Depots, Operations, Production, Procurement and external suppliers, you’ll ensure stock is available when needed, identify potential shortages and proactively resolve supply issues.

What will I be doing? 

- Take ownership of digital screen buffer stock across UK and European locations, ensuring accurate stock records, reconciliations and availability.
- Manage stock requests, purchase orders, ordering and replenishment, ensuring requests are processed and dispatched on time.
- Work closely with Production and Repairs to forecast demand, manage production and supplier lead times and maintain a reliable delivery pipeline.

We’re looking for a Town Planning Manager to join our Portfolio team and play a significant role in delivering our digital strategy.
What you’ll be doing…
As a Planning Manager, you’ll be responsible for securing planning permissions and advertisement consents for new and existing advertising locations. You’ll provide expert planning advice across the business, helping us develop our nationwide digital advertising presence and deliver our wider portfolio objectives.
Working closely with your fellow Planning Managers and colleagues across the business, you’ll prioritise planning applications and appeals to support our site development programme and business strategy.

We're one of the UK's leading Out of Home media and infrastructure companies, operating more than 33,000 sites nationwide and looking after nearly 22,000 bus shelters.
